system.description: Holy Houdini! While anyone can use Dexterity to wiggle out of restraints or a hold, you're especially skilled at the art of escape. When you try to escape from bonds or being Held, you can use this Skill. When trying to escape bonds, make an Unopposed Skill Check. To escape being Held, make a STR-Opposed Skill Check. Based on the complexity or simplicity of what binds you, the GM may have you make the Check with Advantage or Disadvantage. On Success, you escape your bonds or the creature holding you.

upgrades.description: You can escape your bonds, and no one sees you do it. If you escape being Held, you can then take a Step (also unseen).
When other crawlers in your party roll this skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage).
When you slip out, you may immediately take an Action with Advantage.
